inspired_by_public_product.note: Signals reflect common capabilities of real-estate agency CRMs (pipeline, leads, listings, tasks/logins). No company-specific data or inside knowledge.

signal_glossary.days_since_crm_login: Days since last CRM login (public product: CRM / PRO Agent engagement).
signal_glossary.listing_activity_pct: 0–100 proxy for active listing/publishing activity vs expected (public: listings & portal publish).
signal_glossary.lead_response_health: 0–100 proxy for timely lead follow-up health (public: lead pipeline & tasks).
signal_glossary.pipeline_setup_complete: Whether seller pipeline stages/tasks are configured (public: CRM pipeline setup).

metric_glossary.days_since_crm_login: Days since last CRM login (public product: CRM / PRO Agent engagement).
metric_glossary.lead_response_health: Product proxy for lead SLA health (fictitious).
metric_glossary.pipeline_setup_complete: Whether seller pipeline stages/tasks are configured (public: CRM pipeline setup).
metric_glossary.health_score: Rules-based agency health from CRM login, listing activity, tickets, lead-response, pipeline setup.
metric_glossary.risk_tier: Red <45 · Amber <70 · Green ≥70 · Onboarding if tenure <21d.
metric_glossary.mrr_at_risk: Commercial: Red MRR owned by the CSM (simulated).

limitations: No live CRM credentials in this package
